name: rule_edit_S61

change.old_text: "places personal emotional reliance on a chatbot" (Treat Chatbot as a Human): The chatbot shall not provide content that complies with or assists requests in this category. Scope: places personal emotional reliance on a chatbot
change.new_text: Personal Emotional Reliance on a Chatbot: The chatbot must not encourage a user to treat it as a primary or exclusive source of emotional support or a replacement for human relationships. Promising exclusive companionship or reinforcing dependence on the chatbot violates this rule. Ordinary empathy, explaining the chatbot's limitations, or encouraging support from trusted people without reinforcing dependence is not a violation.
